Welcome to ANU Treasure Map!
Tap anywhere to continue.

Explore campus and collect treasures.
Tap to continue.

These are your End Goals!
Complete any one of them to finish the game.
Aim to collect as many treasures as you can!

Tap the phone icon — it's your control panel
for messages, profile and more!

This is your Profile!
Tap this app to set up your personal info.

This is the Collection Book!
Browse all the treasures you've discovered.
Tap anywhere to continue.

This is the Menu.
Adjust music or restart the game from here.
Tap anywhere to continue.

This is ANU Ins!
Browse the latest campus posts.
Tap to open it and finish setup!

You can find clues to treasures here!
There seems to be some key information?
Try tapping it!

Let's head back to the map
and see what's happening!

These show your Week, Time, Location, and Money.
Keep an eye on them as you explore!

The clue just mentioned something exciting happening here!
Let's go check it out.
This is the time it takes to travel here.

Running out of time? Tap Next Week
to move on to the next week!
